summary: Two snowshoers and their dog killed by an avalanche near Hoosier Pass; avalanche rescue dog located them buried ~2 p.m. Sunday after an SCRG/Flight for Life search
location: North Star Mountain, Hoosier Pass area
responding_agency: Summit County Rescue Group + Flight for Life Lifeguard 2 + Summit County Sheriff
notes: CAIC: ~400-ft-wide D2 avalanche, 250 vertical feet, broke into old snow layers at ~11,700 ft; couple reported missing Sunday morning Jan 9 after failing to return from a Saturday snowshoe outing; cause of death blunt force trauma and asphyxiation (Summit County coroner); dog also deceased.
